questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the:
questions.explanation: One weber equals one tesla times one square metre. Tesla is the unit of magnetic field and henry that of inductance, so a weber per second is a volt.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The magnifying power of an astronomical telescope in normal adjustment is given by:
questions.explanation: A high magnification therefore needs an objective of long focal length and an eyepiece of short focal length, and the tube length is f(o) + f(e).
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 9: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A simple pendulum is taken inside an artificial satellite orbiting the Earth. Its time period will:
options: Become infinite, so the pendulum does not oscillate at all
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(l/g), and inside an orbiting satellite everything is in free fall, so the effective g is zero. With no restoring force the bob simply stays where it is put.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Starch, the storage polysaccharide of plants, is made up of:
questions.explanation: Amylose is a long unbranched helical chain and amylopectin a highly branched one. The helix of amylose traps iodine, which is why starch gives the familiar blue colour.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The standard emf of a galvanic cell is calculated as:
questions.explanation: Both values are taken as reduction potentials, so subtracting the anode's from the cathode's gives the cell emf. A positive answer means the cell reaction is spontaneous.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For a reaction in which the number of moles of gas does not change, that is Δn(g) = 0, the relation between ΔH and ΔU is:
questions.explanation: ΔH = ΔU + Δn(g)RT, so when Δn(g) is zero the pressure-volume work term vanishes and the two become identical. The reaction H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl is one such case, with two moles of gas on each side.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The cell walls of diatoms are indestructible and pile up over time to form a substance used in filtration and polishing, called:
questions.explanation: The walls are embedded with silica, which does not decay. Diatoms are also the chief producers of the oceans, so they support almost all marine food chains.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: tRNA is called an adaptor molecule during translation because it:
options: Reads the codon on mRNA at one end and carries the matching amino acid at the other
questions.explanation: The anticodon loop base pairs with the codon while the amino acid sits at the opposite end, so tRNA is what physically translates nucleotide language into protein language.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The organ of Corti, which contains the hair cells that actually convert sound vibrations into nerve impulses, is located in the:
questions.explanation: It rests on the basilar membrane inside the coiled cochlea. Damage to these hair cells is the usual cause of permanent hearing loss, since they do not regenerate.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The common cold, caused by rhinoviruses, differs from many other viral diseases in that it:
options: Infects the lungs and causes lasting immunity
Infects the nose and respiratory passage but not the lungs, and confers no lasting immunity
Can be cured completely by antibiotics
questions.explanation: There are well over a hundred rhinovirus types, so recovering from one gives no protection against the next, and being viral it does not respond to antibiotics at all.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
